comment: The Passwall Node upgrade policy: which releases this panel may offer as an upgrade target. revision is a monotonic publication counter: a higher number supersedes a lower one, and a lower one is refused rather than applied. REVISION 2 IS THE SINGLE-SCHEME REGISTRY. The legacy scheme was removed - there is no production deployment, so nothing needed migrating off it - and the two v0.0.1-beta releases that were listed here are not versions any more, nor are the three beta refusals decisions about names that can still be requested. What replaces them is the release the products actually publish. THE PATH MODEL IS GONE from this document: which releases may be offered is this list, and a path between two of them is no longer a separate thing to certify.

applies_to_psp.comment: The PSP versions this revision was reviewed for. A build outside this range must not apply it. This is separate from the FIRST segment of a product version, which is a release line and not a compatibility major.

releases.comment: The first product-scheme release, and the version both products are on. The evidence named is the one that exists: the v1 node wire, verified by the released-range matrix against this release's pinned commit. Nothing here claims a path to it from anywhere else.
